source_note: The operating frame and alignment criteria are now anchored to direct source language from the private MeOS Saturn Return Companion supplied by the user on 2026-09-05. Domain bucket labels remain reconstructed classifications unless a later source confirms verbatim historical labels.
north_star: Build the life that can carry who you are.
chapter_frame: This chapter is asking for adult authorship, not perfection. Choose what you will build, lead, sustain—and no longer carry.

morning_compass.title: Remember who you are.
morning_compass.statement: I can act before certainty is perfect and build slowly enough to carry consequence.

daily_rule.title: One durable commitment.
daily_rule.prompt: What is the one action that creates lasting value today?

quick_return.title: Clarity before volume.
quick_return.rule: One recognized insight · one clean boundary · one durable action · a pace worth repeating.

decision_compass.title: The Perceptive Architect
decision_compass.subtitle: A practical decision compass for personal and professional choices
decision_compass.canonical_note: TK decided 2026-09-06 that the seven-check decision reference is canonical. alignment_dimensions above is retained as the companion's recorded six-check Alignment Test variant and is not the instrument.
decision_compass.warning: Pause. This may be proving, urgency, or an old contract in disguise.

checks.name: Recognition
checks.question: Is my judgment genuinely valued here, or am I trying to convince people to see what I see?

checks.name: Environment
checks.question: Do I become clearer and more like myself in this place and around these people?

checks.name: Body
checks.question: After rest and food, does my body soften toward this choice or remain contracted?

checks.name: Reciprocity
checks.question: Are responsibility, attention, honesty, and care moving in both directions?

checks.name: Foundation
checks.question: Will this create durable value, or only urgency, activity, and appearance?

checks.name: Freedom
checks.question: Does the structure preserve enough autonomy, movement, and room to experiment?

checks.name: Reality test
checks.question: What consistent behavior or evidence supports the story I am telling myself?

green_lights: Time to think and speak aloud
red_flags: A body that stays tense or depleted
Rigid routine with no room to explore
decision_compass.when_unclear: Do not force an immediate answer. Change environments, talk it through with a trusted listener, sleep, restore the body, and notice which explanation sounds increasingly true over time.
decision_compass.default_priority: Protect clarity first: right environment, then regulated body, then honest dialogue, then evidence, then commitment.
decision_compass.closing: Recognition is not the same as approval. You do not need everyone to agree; you need the right people to understand and value the contribution.

evening_evidence.title: Close the loop.
prompts: What did I build, clarify, or protect?
What am I no longer carrying?

next_personal_year_prompt: Review what deserves another year of your life.

goals.name: Build & Own
goals.description: Build durable products, intellectual property, ownership, and leverage rather than optimizing only for income or activity.
success_signals: first paid client or revenue evidence

goals.name: Visible Leadership
goals.description: Become known for one valuable point of view and capability by making the thinking, evidence, and work legible in public.
success_signals: clear association with a valuable capability

goals.name: Relationship Equity
goals.description: Build with the right people, strengthen collaboration, and create relationships that compound beyond a single transaction.

goals.name: Modeling & Presence
goals.description: Re-establish modeling as an active creative and professional practice with current work, visibility, and collaboration.

goals.name: Music & Creative Return
goals.description: Keep writing, recording, releasing, and returning to singing and performance as a real creative practice.

goals.name: Writing & Art
goals.description: Make essays, poetry, visual work, and field notes visible as part of the broader creative practice.

goals.name: Learning & Capability
goals.description: Deepen agentic, technical, creative, and operating capability while turning learning into reusable systems and teaching.
success_signals: learning applied to a live build
